info.name: Lago API documentation Add_ons Fees API

params.name: external_customer_id
params.description: Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application.

params.name: fee_type
params.description: The fee type. Possible values are `add-on`, `charge`, `credit` or `subscription`.

params.name: billable_metric_code
params.description: Filter results by the `code` of the billable metric attached to the fee. Only applies to `charge` types.

params.name: payment_status
params.description: Indicates the payment status of the fee. It represents the current status of the payment associated with the fee. The possible values for this field are `pending`, `succeeded`, `failed` and refunded`.

params.name: created_at_from
params.description: Filter results created after creation date and time in UTC.

params.name: created_at_to
params.description: Filter results created before creation date and time in UTC.

params.name: succeeded_at_from
params.description: Filter results with payment success after creation date and time in UTC.

params.name: succeeded_at_to
params.description: Filter results with payment success after creation date and time in UTC.

params.name: failed_at_from
params.description: Filter results with payment failure after creation date and time in UTC.

params.name: failed_at_to
params.description: Filter results with payment failure after creation date and time in UTC.

params.name: refunded_at_from
params.description: Filter results with payment refund after creation date and time in UTC.

params.name: refunded_at_to
params.description: Filter results with payment refund after creation date and time in UTC.

items.docs: This endpoint is used for retrieving all fees that has been issued.
